title: Adventures in Silverado
description: A stagecoach driver seeks to capture "The Monk," a notorious highwayman, in order to clear himself.

title: Seminole Uprising
description: An Army lieutenant (George Montgomery) is ordered to go after Florida Indians in Texas.

title: Gunfighters
description: A gunfighter (Randolph Scott) turns cowhand and then back again, fighting a cattle baron with two daughters (Barbara Britton, Dorothy Hart).

title: Phantom Stagecoach
description: A dispute between stage lines ends with a steel-armored stagecoach.

title: Go West, Young Lady
description: A saloon dancer (Ann Miller) and a tomboy (Penny Singleton) from back East fight over their town's new marshal (Glenn Ford).

title: The Gun That Won the West
description: Superior Springfield rifles help scouts (Dennis Morgan, Richard Denning) and the cavalry get forts built in Wyoming.

title: Apache Ambush
description: On a cattle drive to Kansas after the Civil War, an ex-Union soldier comes up against Apache and Confederate renegades.

title: The Professionals
description: A circa-1917 rancher sends mercenaries (Lee Marvin, Burt Lancaster) to rescue his kidnapped wife (Claudia Cardinale) from a Mexican bandit.

title: 3:10 to Yuma
description: A rancher (Van Heflin) needing cash is hired to put an outlaw (Glenn Ford) on the train to Yuma prison.

title: Wyoming Renegades
description: An ex-convict (Phil Carey) and his girlfriend (Martha Hyer) cannot start over until they stop Butch Cassidy's (Gene Evans) gang.

title: Blackjack Ketchum, Desperado
description: A gunfighter (Howard Duff) wants peace in the valley, but a cattle baron (Victor Jory) and his brothers want war.

title: The Guns of Fort Petticoat
description: An Army deserter (Audie Murphy) shows defenseless Texas women how to hold off Indians out to avenge a massacre.

title: Go West, Young Girl!
description: New England writer Netty and cavalry widow Gilda team up to find Billy the Kid.

title: Edge of Eternity
description: An Arizona lawman (Cornel Wilde) traps a killer gold thief (Mickey Shaughnessy) and his hostage (Victoria Shaw) in a yellow tram spanning the Grand Canyon.

title: The Violent Men
description: A rancher (Glenn Ford) fights a land-grabbing cattle baron (Edward G. Robinson) whose wife (Barbara Stanwyck) and brother are having an affair.

title: The Nebraskan
description: War looms on the horizon when an Army officer's American Indian aide is accused of murdering a tribal elder.

title: Gun Fury
description: A peaceful man (Rock Hudson) hunts down the outlaw (Phil Carey) who has abducted his bride (Donna Reed).

title: Apache Territory
description: A drifter crossing the Arizona desert routs a band of marauding Apaches and rescues the young survivor of a massacre.

title: 7th Cavalry
description: Absent from Custer's Last Stand, an Army captain (Randolph Scott) volunteers for the Little Bighorn burial detail.

title: Laramie Mountains
description: The Durango Kid learns that crooked scouts are behind attempts to escalate a war between a local tribe and the cavalry.

title: Last of the Comanches
description: A cavalry sergeant (Broderick Crawford) leads soldiers, civilians and an Indian (Johnny Stewart) on a desert trek.

title: Comanche Station
description: Three outlaws join a loner (Randolph Scott) and another man's wife (Nancy Gates), who was kidnapped by Indians.

title: The Great Sioux Massacre
description: The story of Gen. Custer (Philip Carey) and the Little Bighorn is seen through the eyes of two of his subordinates (Joseph Cotten, Darren McGavin).

title: Man in the Saddle
description: A wounded rancher (Randolph Scott) hides with a schoolmarm (Ellen Drew) after his ex-girlfriend's husband (Alexander Knox) runs him out of town.

title: Masterson of Kansas
description: Bat Masterson (George Montgomery), Doc Holliday (James Griffith) and Wyatt Earp rescue a framed rancher and stop an Indian war.

title: Return of the Durango Kid

title: Legend of the Golden Gun
description: An Old West gunfighter (Hal Holbrook) turns a young farmer (Jeff Osterhage) into a justice fighter with a special gun.

title: The Return of Wild Bill
description: Wild Bill Saunders comes home to help his father deal with troublesome ranchers.

title: Sierra Stranger
